See your own anatomy

Real 3D anatomy pinned to your face and hands, or to your whole body in Full body mode (stand back so you are fully in view). In 3D mode you can orbit the model, or let it copy your pose live.

Video is processed on this device and never uploaded.

About

The anatomy is a real 3D dataset of one adult, scaled and pinned to your head or body. It shows where structures typically sit, not a scan of you, and it is not a medical tool. The nerves are a schematic drawn along the spine and joints, not dissected anatomy. Video is processed on this device and never uploaded.
